notes.title: A Thug's Ascension out now on Steam
notes.content: Hello everyone! Adi here, lead dev of [i]ATA[/i] and creative director at Moonwalk. It gives me great pleasure to announce that [i]A Thug's Ascension[/i] has now been released on Steam for Windows and macOS. After five long years of development, this is a very proud moment for me and the Moonwalk team and we are delighted to be finally sharing this story with all of you. If you are interested in the game, please head over to the store-page and buy yourself a copy, and do also tell your friends/family who you think might be into it as well! In case you find any bugs, glitches, or any other kind of problems, please let me know through our support email moonwalk.entertainment.es@gmail.com and I will be happy to sort it out. If you like the game, please give it a positive review on Steam!

notes.title: A Thug's Ascension - Exclusive Gameplay Demo
notes.content:
Welcome to the exclusive gameplay demo walkthrough of Moonwalk's upcoming narrative action-adventurer, [i]A Thug's Ascension[/i], where we will be taking an early look at one of the biggest and bloodiest sequences in the game: the Battle of the Great Bridge.
